audienceSegments: VP or Director of Engineering at a B2B SaaS company operating a production AI agent that can create or update external business records
buyingSituation: The team has recently given an AI agent write access to CRM, ticketing, email, billing, or deployment tools and cannot demonstrate what happens when a mutation commits but its acknowledgement is lost.
primaryMetric: qualified discovery calls from verified trigger-backed accounts

claims.text: EffectProof tests whether one durable intent produces the intended number of external effects through retries, lost acknowledgements, and recovery.
limitations: Current downstream providers are simulated; a PASS does not prove a live vendor integration is safe.

claims.text: EffectProof distinguishes a recovered idempotent retry from a duplicate mutation by inspecting authoritative simulated state.
limitations: Authoritative inspection is adapter-dependent and currently uses in-process simulated stores.

experiment.hypothesis: A concrete commit-succeeds-ack-lost message sent only to verified write-capable-agent teams will produce at least 3 qualified replies from 20 independently triggered accounts.
experiment.killCriterion: Stop and revise after 20 verified trigger-backed accounts if fewer than 3 qualified replies identify the problem as current and consequential. Do not increase volume based on sends, opens, or clicks.

commercialProposal.discovery: $0 for a 30-minute problem interview; no credentials or production access
commercialProposal.pilot: $2,500 fixed-fee hypothesis for one sanitized workflow, one custom simulated scenario, and one evidence review
commitments: No compliance certification or penetration-test claim
No promise that a simulated PASS proves a live integration
Scope and acceptance criteria agreed before paid work

approvalEvidence.scope: EffectProof discovery v1 claims, offer, $2,500 pilot pricing hypothesis, and listed commitments
